description: Blinq is redefining professional identity for the hybrid world, turning every interaction into an opportunity. With dynamic digital profiles, instant sharing across QR, NFC, and video, and deep CRM integrations, Blinq empowers individuals and enterprises to capture, manage, and activate relationships at scale all while building a proprietary network powered by an AI-first roadmap.

Checkbox is an intake and workflow automation platform allowing legal teams to capture and manage requests from the business, gain visibility & control over matters, and automate manual work. With Checkbox, spend less time on manual, administrative work, and more time being the legal function that partners and grows together with the business.

CuspAI is applying current breakthroughs in generative AI to the scientific process, paving the way for the scalable and more rapid development of novel materials solutions to key global challenges like lowering carbon emissions at scale.

Daloopa pioneered an AI-driven technology to source, organize and distribute the most comprehensive historical datasets for financial institutions globally, enabling them to meet time-critical data discovery requirements during earnings and model building workflows to accelerate an analyst’s time to insight.

Exaforce multiplies the productivity of security and operations teams by 10× through its Agentic Security Operations Center (SOC) Platform powered by a semantic data fabric and autonomous Exabots. It delivers real-time insights, proactive detection and response, and automated investigations, transforming how teams handle threat detection, analysis, and remediation at scale.

Infinity is an AI infrastructure company that automates the software needed to make any AI chip ready to run modern AI models. Using autonomous AI agents, Infinity enables chip companies to optimize performance in days instead of years, accelerating time to market and unlocking the full potential of new AI hardware.

Netradyne is revolutionizing fleet safety with AI-powered video telematics and edge computing solutions that monitor driver behavior in real time. From accident prevention to operational cost reduction, Netradyne’s technology empowers fleets to drive safer and more efficient operations, setting a new benchmark for the industry.

Numa is transforming the automotive industry by building an AI-native platform designed to revolutionize dealership operations. Leveraging advanced AI agents, Numa automates customer interactions, enhances operational efficiency, and boosts dealership productivity.

With their codeless AI infrastructure, Pixis is democratizing artificial intelligence for marketers, agencies, and creative professionals, helping brands in scaling all aspects of their marketing and augmenting their decision-making in a world of infinitely complex consumer behavior.

ProRata is redefining digital publishing with ethical AI search, advertising, and attribution solutions that put creators first. By powering trusted, licensed generative AI experiences, ProRata enables publishers to drive engagement, unlock new revenue streams, and thrive in the evolving digital economy.

SafeBase is creating a new standard for how companies build and maintain trust with their customers. Their innovative technology empowers organizations to proactively communicate with their customers about security and privacy updates and gives them the tools to build trust at scale.

SafelyYou is transforming senior living care through AI-powered solutions that predict and address residents’ needs with unmatched accuracy. From fall prevention to care measurement, SafelyYou’s technology enhances resident outcomes, improves operational efficiency, and sets a new standard for person-centered care in the industry.

SlashExperts helps B2B companies accelerate revenue by connecting prospective buyers with real customers. The platform builds trust, shortens sales cycles, and influences pipeline with attribution-ready insights that seamlessly integrate into CRM systems, delivering measurable impact at every stage of the buyer journey.

Wingspan is the first payroll platform purpose-built for contingent work, helping companies streamline onboarding, automate payments, offload 1099 processing and provide contractors access to better benefits.
